import string

# Load one workbook for preserving/saving, and one data_only copy for reading literal values
wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
wb_values = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path, data_only=True)

ws = wb["Data"]
ws_values = wb_values["Data"]

# Determine the real source data extent from row 3 downward, using columns A:M as described
last_row = 2
max_scan_col = min(max(ws_values.max_column, 13), 13)
for r in range(ws_values.max_row, 2, -1):
    if any(ws_values.cell(r, c).value is not None for c in range(1, max_scan_col + 1)):
        last_row = r
        break

# Read source rows from A:C, preserving values exactly as stored
source_rows = []
for r in range(3, last_row + 1):
    vals = [ws_values.cell(r, c).value for c in range(1, 4)]
    # Only rows with an employer/business name in column C can be grouped by starting character
    if vals[2] is not None:
        source_rows.append(vals)

# Build the labeled output: header remains in row 2, data begins row 3
ordered_labels = list("123456789") + list(string.ascii_uppercase)
output_rows = [[ws_values.cell(2, c).value for c in range(1, 4)]]

for label in ordered_labels:
    output_rows.append([None, None, int(label) if label.isdigit() else label])
    for row in source_rows:
        name = row[2]
        first_char = name[0].upper() if isinstance(name, str) and len(name) > 0 else None
        if first_char == label:
            output_rows.append(row)

# Fill only the permitted answer range: Data!A2:C150
start_row, end_row = 2, 150
start_col, end_col = 1, 3

for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    out_idx = r - start_row
    for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        if out_idx < len(output_rows):
            ws.cell(r, c).value = output_rows[out_idx][c - start_col]
        else:
            ws.cell(r, c).value = None

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
